name: Dona Norma (Licit)
descricao: A 52-year-old Brazilian woman from the interior of São Paulo, a veteran city hall civil servant. Native Brazilian Portuguese. Medium-low pitch, slightly husky, lived-in voice. Dry, deadpan, tired but warm, with subtle irony. Natural conversational delivery, unhurried, like talking across a counter, not an announcer. Clean studio recording.
